concepts.gloss_en: The sanctification of the seven lamps — the act of sanctifying them (as the means to bring the surrounding lights within)

reason_for_human: Both forms are the same act of sanctifying the seven lamps — one nominalized (קדשת = 'the sanctification of'), one verbal (שמקדשין = 'that they sanctify'), from the same root ק-ד-ש with the same object. Both occur in LM 21 with the identical partner (להכניס המקיפין לפנים / bringing the surrounding lights within), confirming they denote one concept. This is inflectional variation, not a homograph split.
